dsh-model-palette
Global provider-aware model command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web
Alt+M  ·  Fuzzy search  ·  Provider filter  ·  Model config  ·  OpenRouter media
**dsh-model-palette** is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness that replaces the native model selector with
a powerful, global command palette. Press **Alt+M** from anywhere in the Web UI — or click the compo
ser trigger — and instantly search, filter, favorite, and switch models across all your providers.
Project site: jensen-yao.github.io/dsh-model-palette
Current release: v0.19.1
The plugin bridges DSH 0.1 native settings and DSH 0.2 profile-backed SettingsForms. Version 0.17 ad
ds selected-provider JSON backups, batch import previews, model-type filters, sorting and progressiv
e results. The bundled preset registry contains 487 entries.
### Quick profiles and previous-model switching
Open **Quick profiles** to name the current provider/model/reasoning combination, such as Coding, Qu
ick questions or Deep thinking. Save up to twelve profiles; the first three appear beside the compos
er and use **Alt+Shift+1/2/3**. Rename, update from the current selection, reorder or delete with un
do. Saving an existing name updates its combination. Profiles stay in this browser origin, contain n
o credentials, and synchronize across tabs and composer seats. Missing models retain their profiles
and show why selection is unavailable.
The **↶** composer button or **Alt+Shift+M** switches back to the previous model in this session, in
cluding its prior reasoning effort. Changing only the reasoning level does not replace previous-mode
l history. Failed selection preserves the active model; locked seats and in-flight selections reject
repeated shortcut actions.
Search accepts compact spellings such as `gpt5`, full-width characters, `is:free is:reasoning`, Chin
ese `免费 推理`, and `@provider` terms. Precise matches rank before favorites while searching. **Reset f
ilters** clears all filters and sorting. Closing a dirty configuration editor or leaving it through
the sidebar now asks before discarding its draft; active settings writes must finish first.
### Keyless free models and local gateway
The native **dsh-free-models** provider combines the keyless Kilo free pool with OpenCode's explicit
free ids. Kilo contributes only rows its own catalog marks `isFree`; OpenCode keeps its public-pool
session wire. Availability probes use small real requests but remove a model only after an explicit
400/404/422 routing refusal — a 429, timeout, or 5xx leaves it selectable. Free pools can log promp
ts upstream, so do not send secrets through them.
A loopback OpenAI-compatible gateway also listens on `http://127.0.0.1:4180/v1` by default and serve
s `/models` plus streaming/non-streaming `/chat/completions`. It binds only to loopback; set `freeMo
dels.gateway.credentialRef` to require a bearer token from a configured DSH credential. Response fra
ming is detected from body bytes, so an SSE stream mislabelled as JSON remains readable.

### Configuration backup and batch import
Open **Model config → Configuration backup & batch import**. Choose saved providers and export their
model parameters, retry rules and free-sync schedules as JSON. Unsaved drafts, API keys, request he
aders and sync diagnostics are excluded; credential references remain names. URLs containing user in
formation, query parameters or fragments are omitted and listed for review. Configure credentials se
parately on the destination host.
Choose a JSON file up to 2 MiB to preview an import, select the providers, and choose **Skip existin
g** (default), **Merge incoming fields**, or **Create copies**. Merge preserves unmentioned provider
fields and replaces incoming model lists; copies retain the source credential reference. Only **App
ly import** writes settings. Revisions protect concurrent changes. Provider settings and palette rul
es are separate writes: if the second write fails, the panel reports the saved provider settings and
asks you to reload and review the rules.
### Model filtering and synchronization
The palette combines provider, search, favorites and recent filters with **Reasoning** or explicit *
*`:free` routes**. Sort by frequent use, model name or provider name. Results render 80 rows at a ti
me; **Show more** and arrow-key navigation reveal later results. Capacity badges resolve the display
ed models through DSH rather than relying on fields absent from the native model directory. Modal fo
cus stays inside the palette and returns to its trigger on close; IME composition does not select mo
tays inside the palette and returns to its trigger on close; IME composition does not select models.
Free sync retains configured models when OpenRouter returns an empty compatible catalog, rechecks ro
ute settings after fetching, and aborts catalog requests during plugin disposal. `intervalHours: 0`
disables interval synchronization while retaining startup and manual synchronization. Unique renamed
SettingsForms entries are recognized by their editable fields; ambiguous entries fail with a list o
ntries are recognized by their editable fields; ambiguous entries fail with a list of candidate ids.
## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Global Command Palette
- **Alt+M** shortcut works from anywhere
- Renders in a document-level

dialog independent from the composer layout
- One unified fuzzy search over model names, model IDs,

provider names, and provider IDs
- Arrow-key navigation and Enter to select

### 🏷️ Provider Filter Rail
- Side rail lists every provider with live model counts
- Click any prov

ider to filter; click "All providers" to reset
- Current provider auto-highlighted at the top
- Visu
al indicators for provider catalog errors

### 🔒 Safety & Privacy
- API keys masked by default; stored in DSH credentials service
- Credential

reveal restricted to loopback connections only
- Cross-site request forgery protection on all plugin

APIs
- OpenRouter credential never returned to the browser
- One-time charge acknowledgement for no

credential never returned to the browser
- One-time charge acknowledgement for non-free media models
## 📋 Requirements

- **Node.js** >= 22.19
- **DeepSeek Harness** 0.1.6-alpha.2 or the supported 0.2 alpha series (see p

ackage peer dependencies); Cordis has its own version
- **pnpm** >= 11.21 (for development)
